meta.name: react-three-fiber
meta.description: Build 3D applications with React Three Fiber (R3F), the React renderer for Three.js. Use this skill when building 3D scenes with React, using declarative JSX for 3D objects, integrating Three.js with React state/lifecycle, or using Drei helpers. Covers Canvas setup, hooks, Drei utilities, performance patterns, and state management for 3D React apps.
